name: Paul & Shark
why: Varese family knit mill (1921) turned yachting house — Typhoon 20000 and the shark, worn on Portofino decks and Manchester terraces alike.
origin: The Dini family's 1921 Varese knit mill; the yachting brand launched 1975 from an 18th-century sail marked 'Paul & Shark.'
opview: Positions itself as yachting luxury with a mill's bones — Typhoon 20000 as proof.

onething.n: brand calls it 'the iconic Typhoon 20000'; collection page verified ✓. Supersedes the Eclisse blouson link — Eclisse was a verified URL, Typhoon is the signature

notes.ital: The Dini family at Masnago near Varese, marine outfitting since 1975, built on a yarn mill the family already owned. Italian in origin, nautical in register, and the two rarely separate.

cities: Select US boutiques · dept stores · Milan flagship, strong across Europe & Asia
